subject.title: [Feature Request] Add streamTo="parent" support for runtime="subagent"

question: Should native `runtime="subagent"` support `streamTo="parent"`, and what child progress, tool data, redaction, and routing contract may cross into the parent session or channel?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally keep `streamTo` ACP-only; implementing it for native subagents changes the isolation and visibility boundary between child sessions, parent agents, and user-facing channels.

options.title: Design redacted native progress relay
options.body: Expose bounded lifecycle/progress summaries first, with requester routing, cleanup, timeout, and redaction tests before any tool-result or thinking visibility.

options.title: Keep `streamTo` ACP-only
options.body: Document native subagents as completion-only and rely on `/subagents`, task ledger, and completion handoffs for inspection.

options.title: Design a broader child event stream
options.body: Create a structured native child-event subscription surface, but require a larger design for tool output, thinking visibility, and channel delivery limits.

recommendation.title: Design redacted native progress relay
recommendation.body: Expose bounded lifecycle/progress summaries first, with requester routing, cleanup, timeout, and redaction tests before any tool-result or thinking visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest current-main routing signal for the touched `sessions_spawn` compatibility surface and is likely best placed to decide whether this crosses a core security boundary.
